subject: Final Proposed Medford City Charter Approval
overview: In its final meeting, the committee voted to approve the draft charter and final report for submission to the mayor after 22 months of deliberation. The approved package includes a modernized charter structure, ward-based representation, and revised mayoral terms.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Approval of Draft Charter
items.summary: Approved the draft charter document following a discussion regarding mayoral authority to remove department heads and the decision to recommend a compensation committee via ordinance rather than charter provision.

items.title: Discussion of Legislative and Ballot Process
items.summary: The committee discussed the legal requirements for the charter to reach the ballot, noting it will be presented to voters as a single all-or-nothing question after reviews by the mayor, City Council, and state legislature.

items.title: Approval of Final Report
items.summary: Approved the committee’s final report with amendments to include statistics on subcommittee meetings, a detailed list of interviewed city officials, and clarifying references to new charter articles.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident thanked the committee for their work while expressing disappointment that more members of the community did not participate in the study process.

items.title: Committee Status and Future Meetings
items.summary: The body discussed its conclusion and potential future involvement as the City Council’s governance committee begins its own charter review process.
